description: Use this when the user wants a daily digest or content ideas for a niche, such as "give me today's AI digest" or "content ideas for marketing". Pass niche (ai, developer-tools, startups, marketing, ecommerce, security, or the user's own words, read as the closest niche or a keyword search; leave it out for everything) and optionally limit. Returns the top posts of the last 3 days that are still on their sources' lists, the top 5 for each source, rising keywords, post counts per niche, how the niche was read (match) and a link to the digest page.

niche.description: A niche (ai, developer-tools, startups, marketing, ecommerce, security) or the user's own words. Other words go to the closest niche, or else become a keyword search over the same sources; the answer's match says which. Leave it out for everything.

name: trending_digest

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

engagement.description: The source's own count at the last read, in unit

heat.description: 0 to 100, rank against the other posts of the same source

unit.description: points, reactions, stars or views; null for Product Hunt, which publishes no count

match.description: How requested was read: as given, the closest niche, or a keyword search

niche.description: The niche used: a slug, all, or null for a keyword search

engagement.description: The source's own count at the last read, in unit

heat.description: 0 to 100, rank against the other posts of the same source

unit.description: points, reactions, stars or views; null for Product Hunt, which publishes no count

requested.description: The niche text the call sent

change_percent.description: Change of the word's share of titles, last 3 days against the 3 days before

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

title: Daily trend digest for a niche
